opportunities.name: Profession-specific Claude/ChatGPT prompt guide sold via Etsy marketplace search (not owned channels)
opportunities.summary: Buyers who type 'chatgpt prompts small business' or 'claude ai prompts small business' into Etsy search buy short PDF prompt guides for $3-6, with the top listing in this exact search showing 42.7k lifetime sales and 8.3k reviews. This is a redo of run-1's deferred 'vertical Claude/GPT skill bundle' with the fatal assumption removed: the first-dollar path here is pure Etsy SEO/browse discovery, not Gumroad+X+email (Dustan has zero followers and no list to email). Dustan repackages 10-20 prompts from his existing skill library into one PDF for a single buyer type (e.g. solo consultants/freelancers) and lists it directly on Etsy under proven high-volume search terms.

claims.statement: The Etsy listing 'Small Business AI Marketing | Claude & ChatGPT Prompt Guide' shows 42.7k sales and 8.3k reviews at $5.33, with a 'Bestseller' badge for high sales volume over the past 6 months.
claims.source_excerpt: 4.9 (8.3k) · 42.7k sales · 5 years on Etsy ... Bestseller This item has had a high sales volume over the past 6 months.

claims.statement: A near-identical, newly-listed competitor product in the same search ('AI Prompt Pack for Small Business | 50+ ChatGPT Prompts') shows 0 sales after 5 months on Etsy, proving the format has real dispersion: top listings win big, most new entrants get nothing.
claims.source_excerpt: ItsSUPA · United States · No reviews yet · 0 sales · 5 months on Etsy

claims.statement: The Etsy search results page for 'chatgpt prompt pack' and related terms shows dozens of active competing listings (from single-digit to 28.9k reviews), confirming heavy competitive density in this exact search term.

opportunities.owned_channel: none required -- buyer arrives via Etsy search/browse
opportunities.fulfillment: Curate 10-20 prompts from Dustan's existing skill/prompt library into one PDF for a single buyer archetype; format and list on Etsy; no new infrastructure.
opportunities.first_dollar_path: List the PDF on Etsy today under the exact search terms the top comp ranks for ('chatgpt prompts small business', 'claude ai prompts'); zero owned audience needed, buyer must find it through Etsy's own search/browse/ads discovery.
why_it_might_fail: This is close enough to run-1's deferred idea #1 that the deferral reason (assumed audience) must be genuinely fixed, not just relabeled -- the whole thesis depends on Etsy SEO ranking, which Dustan has zero track record building.
The 0-sales comp shows most new listings in this exact niche get no organic traffic without paid ads or an existing shop reputation.
Extremely price-anchored ($3-6), leaving thin margin per unit even at volume.
Legal flag: must write 100% original prompts, not lift Anthropic's own published example skills or another seller's PLR content.

Dustan differentiates a plain bookkeeping template by adding a tab of Claude/ChatGPT prompts (e.g. auto-drafted invoice reminders, pricing suggestions) and lists it directly on Etsy under the same proven search terms, organizational only -- no tax advice.

disagreements: The flagship comp (opportunity 1) shows both a review count (8.3k) and a separate, larger visible sales count (42.7k) on the same listing -- a ~5:1 sales-to-review ratio for this specific listing. Lesson 3 explicitly warns against assuming a fixed review-to-sale ratio (one prior listing showed ~100:1), so this 5:1 figure is reported only as a fact about this one listing, not used to estimate sales for any other opportunity's review-count-only comps.

The AEO/GEO prompt-pack comp (opportunity 2) disappeared between being indexed by search and being fetched directly -- this could mean it sold out (strong demand) or was pulled for a policy/trademark reason (bad signal). I could not determine which, so the opportunity is marked demand: unproven rather than assuming the more favorable explanation.
